summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The VictoryShares Dividend Accelerator ETF (VSDA) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Nasdaq Victory Dividend Accelerator index. The fund tracks an index of dividend-paying US large- and mid-cap stocks with a high likelihood of future dividend growth. VSDA was launched on Apr 18, 2017 and is issued by VictoryShares.

holdings.infoBox: VSDA is an equity ETF with a total of 77 individual holdings. The top holdings are Altria Group stock at 3.23%, Medtronic at 3.12%, Kimberly-Clark at 2.91%, Chevron at 2.85%, and Brown-Forman at 2.71%.
